"''That's an eternity.|Syril Karn and the officer|}} A [[human]] '''officer''' lived during the [[Imperial Era]] and worked for [[Consolidated Holdings of Preox-Morlana Corporation|Preox-Morlana]]'s [[Pre-Mor Security Inspection team]] in [[5 BBY]]. When [[Deputy Inspector]] [[Syril Karn]] sought a [[Kenari]] human [[Gender|male]] on [[Ferrix]], [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], for questioning in the [[death]]s of [[Verlo Skiff]] and [[Kravas Drezzer]], the officer participated in the investigation. Karn's arrival to discuss progress in the case interrupted the officer's consumption of [[glowblue noodles]]. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== The officer first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' television series episode "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]."
